name: lw_12165
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a + b + c = 1) : a / (Real.sqrt ((a + c) * (a + b))) + b / (Real.sqrt ((a + b) * (b + c))) + c / (Real.sqrt ((b + c) * (a + c))) ≤ 3 / 2
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hab : a + b + c = 1), a / (Real.sqrt ((a + c) * (a + b))) + b / (Real.sqrt ((a + b) * (b + c))) + c / (Real.sqrt ((b + c) * (a + c))) ≤ 3 / 2
informal: Let $a, b, c > 0$ and $a + b + c = 1$. Prove that:\n$$\frac{a}{\sqrt{(c+a)(a+b)}}+\frac{b}{\sqrt{(a+b)(b+c)}}+\frac{c}{\sqrt{(b+c)(c+a)}}\le \frac {3}{2}.$$
